title: CommCode
description: An independently implemented agent-oriented coding platform with reviewable changes and replaceable model and runtime adapters. This deposit preserves a dated source snapshot of the implementation and documentation, with the limitations stated in the repository.
notes: AGPL-3.0-or-later applies to the platform; templates and third-party components retain their own terms. No model weights are included. Archival publication does not establish peer review, independent validation or production readiness.
